acceptance: Configuration as described in the approved Basic Design Package
section: ER-01 General requirements and plant description
text: The plant shall be a 1x1 multi-shaft combined cycle block comprising one heavy-duty H-class (or equivalent advanced class) gas turbine with its own generator, one triple-pressure reheat heat recovery steam generator (HRSG) with selective catalytic reduction (SCR) and CO catalyst, and one reheat condensing steam turbine with its own generator, cooled by once-through seawater.
title: Plant configuration
